summary: Comprehensive responsive audit across 10 breakpoints (320/375/390/414/480/768/1024/1280/1440/1920) on 6 pages (/, /executive-summary, /investor-pitch-deck, /capital-strategy, /request-access, /admin/login). All 40 page+breakpoint combinations show scrollWidth === clientWidth (zero horizontal scroll). Zero console errors. Visual identity fully preserved: circular founder portraits with orbital rings render correctly at every size, both Darwin (bald w/ glasses) and Jonathan (dark hair) images load. Composition collapses cleanly to vertical stack on mobile and shows full horizontal layout (portrait → PUNTO CERO origin node → portrait) on desktop 1440.

critical_code_review_comments: Note (informational, non-blocking): Prior smoke tests reported 12 internal over-wide elements on /capital-strategy at 320-375px that are visually clipped by parent overflow-x:clip. This does not produce visible horizontal scroll (verified: scrollWidth===clientWidth) but may indicate individual components could benefit from min-width:0 or narrower content to avoid relying on clip-cropping. Not a bug — cosmetic tech-debt.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Responsive audit fully passes at all 10 required breakpoints across all 6 pages. No horizontal scroll anywhere, zero console errors, circular portraits + orbital rings + hover animations preserved. The only lingering (non-visible) issue is 12 over-wide internal elements on /capital-strategy at 320-375px that are clipped by parent overflow-x:clip — this is a known cosmetic tech-debt item, not a functional bug.
